from kohakutpu.language.examples.dsl.vector.softmax import softmax


def facts():
    x = T(XS)
    n0 = len(DEV.runs)
    y = BR.bridge(softmax)(x)
    st = storage(y)
    return {
        "shape": list(y.shape),
        "dtype": y.dtype.name,
        "runs": [r.kind for r in DEV.runs[n0:]],
        "forms": form_keys(st),
        "written_as": str(FM.base_of(st)[0].dtype),
    }
